title: Come join us in our first GBM of the semester!
body: Join ColorStack at SDSU for our first GBM to learn about national membership benefits and get real about academic and career missteps. Share your story or listen in as we demystify failure to boost our professional growth in tech!

title: Become a Member: ColorStack SDSU & National
body: Connect with our SDSU chapter on Discord, then apply online to join the national organization.
